name: request_funnel_by_position
sql:
WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.*,p.execution_mode,p.reason_code personalization_reason
 FROM recommendation_request r LEFT JOIN recommendation_personalization_decision p ON p.request_id=r.id
 WHERE r.created_at >= '2026-09-14T21:30:00Z' AND r.created_at < '2026-09-15T21:30:00Z'
 AND r.expires_at > '2026-09-15T22:35:00Z'
), o AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.episode_id,o.classifier_version) o.* FROM recommendation_outcome_revision o
 JOIN recommendation_playback_episode e ON e.id=o.episode_id JOIN r ON r.id=e.request_id
 WHERE o.created_at < '2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 ORDER BY o.episode_id,o.classifier_version,o.revision DESC
), f AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.surface_version,r.id request_id,r.session_digest,r.created_at,r.locale,r.result,r.fallback_reason,r.seed_media_id,r.execution_mode,r.personalization_reason,
 i.id item_id,i.position,i.target_media_id,i.candidate_generator,i.presentation,
 (rf.id IS NOT NULL) rendered,(im.id IS NOT NULL) impressed,(s.id IS NOT NULL) selected,
 (s.id IS NOT NULL AND im.id IS NOT NULL AND s.occurred_at>=im.occurred_at) selected_after_impression,
 (e.claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND e.claimed_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') claimed,e.id episode_id,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recommendation_playback_fact pf WHERE pf.episode_id=e.id AND pf.kind='playback_start' AND pf.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') started,
 a.id active_outcome,a.qualified_view active_qualified,a.active_playback_milliseconds active_ms,a.active_coverage,a.duration_seconds,a.reasons,
 l.qualified_view legacy_qualified
 FROM r LEFT JOIN recommendation_served_item i ON i.request_id=r.id
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_rendered_fact rf ON rf.item_id=i.id AND rf.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_impression im ON im.item_id=i.id AND im.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_selection s ON s.item_id=i.id AND s.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_playback_episode e ON e.selection_id=s.id AND e.created_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN o a ON a.episode_id=e.id AND a.classifier_version='active-watch-proxy-v1'
 LEFT JOIN o l ON l.episode_id=e.id AND l.classifier_version='legacy-position-v0'
)
SELECT execution_mode,position,count(item_id) cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rendered) rendered,count(*) FILTER(WHERE impressed) impressions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE selected_after_impression) matched_selections,count(*) FILTER(WHERE selected) selections,count(*) FILTER(WHERE started) starts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE active_qualified) qualified FROM f WHERE surface_version='watch-below-player-v1' AND item_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

name: selected_episode_missingness
sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r.id,p.execution_mode FROM recommendation_request r JOIN recommendation_personalization_decision p ON p.request_id=r.id WHERE r.created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND r.created_at<$2::timestamptz AND r.surface_version='watch-below-player-v1'),e AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r.execution_mode,ep.id,ep.claimed_at,ep.state FROM r JOIN recommendation_selection s ON s.request_id=r.id AND s.received_at<$3::timestamptz LEFT JOIN recommendation_playback_episode ep ON ep.selection_id=s.id AND ep.created_at<$3::timestamptz),f AS(SELECT e.*,count(pf.id) facts,bool_or(pf.kind='playback_attempt') attempted,bool_or(pf.kind='playback_start') started,bool_or(pf.kind='playback_error') error,bool_or(pf.kind='playback_end') ended,bool_or(pf.kind='playback_observation') observed FROM e LEFT JOIN recommendation_playback_fact pf ON pf.episode_id=e.id AND pf.received_at<$3::timestamptz AND NOT pf.late GROUP BY e.execution_mode,e.id,e.claimed_at,e.state) SELECT execution_mode,count(*) selections,count(*) FILTER(WHERE id IS NULL) missing_episode,count(*) FILTER(WHERE claimed_at IS NULL) unclaimed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at<$3::timestamptz AND facts=0) claimed_no_facts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attempted AND NOT coalesce(started,false)) attempt_without_start,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT coalesce(started,false) AND error) no_start_error,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT coalesce(started,false) AND ended) no_start_ended,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT coalesce(started,false) AND observed) no_start_observed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE started) starts FROM f GROUP BY 1

name: latest_200_personalized_request_repeat_diagnostic_new_web_20minutes
latest_200_personalized_request_sample_size
sql: SELECT count(*) AS sample_requests FROM (SELECT r.id FROM recommendation_request r JOIN recommendation_personalization_decision p ON p.request_id=r.id WHERE p.execution_mode='hybrid_personalized' AND r.created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND r.created_at<$2::timestamptz ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 200) sample

name: settled_bounded_candidate_suppression
sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r.id FROM recommendation_request r JOIN recommendation_personalization_decision p ON p.request_id=r.id WHERE p.execution_mode='hybrid_personalized' AND r.created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND r.created_at<$2::timestamptz ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 200) SELECT se.stage,count(*) evidence_entries,count(DISTINCT r.id) requests_with_entries,count(*) FILTER(WHERE 'recent_playback_start'=ANY(se.reason_codes)) recent_start_entries,count(*) FILTER(WHERE 'recent_selection'=ANY(se.reason_codes)) recent_selection_entries,count(*) FILTER(WHERE 'repeatedly_served'=ANY(se.reason_codes)) repeatedly_served_entries,count(*) FILTER(WHERE 'refill_after_suppression'=ANY(se.reason_codes)) refill_or_movement_entries FROM r JOIN recommendation_candidate_run cr ON cr.request_id=r.id JOIN recommendation_candidate_stage_evidence se ON se.run_id=cr.id GROUP BY se.stage ORDER BY se.stage
